evidence_this_prereg_is_built_on.source: analysis/gate-net-cost/GATE-NET-COST-2026-09-05.json, `gate_rows_deduped_to_waves` row where gate=='NOT_FLAT' (dedup across bold-2/risky-1/risky-3/safe-2/safe-3), read fresh this session.
evidence_this_prereg_is_built_on.definition_used: net_dollars = sum(realized_if_taken_dollars) over all walk_ok rows for the gate, using the walked (real exit-shape) realized outcome, not the peak-multiple ceiling -- same definition the goal's own table documents and this prereg reuses without re-deriving.
evidence_this_prereg_is_built_on.reading: The headline +$7,543/99-wave full-window number is real but 63.4% of it is one day (2026-08-04, +$4,784); ex-that-day the full window is +$2,759, still positive but far thinner. The frozen (config-freeze, 2026-08-31-onward) window -- the honest forward-looking slice -- reads NEGATIVE at -$631 net (4 of 5 arms individually negative or flat: only bold-2 +$89), i.e. refusing the second wave EARNED money in the frozen window even though it COST money in the full backward window. This is exactly the shape the goal opened to freeze: a headline number driven by one anecdote, reversing sign once the anecdote is excluded from the live-decision window.

right_tail_ledger_second_wave_presence.source: analysis/right-tail/ledger.jsonl (per date/arm `second_wave_summary.present` flag, produced nightly by right_tail_capture.py)
right_tail_ledger_second_wave_presence.note: This is BACKWARD evidence of how often a second independent wave was even available to refuse (a >=60min-gap fresh two-trigger ENTER after the first position reached TP1) -- it is NOT yet a forward-scored second-wave-refusal P&L ledger; that forward accrual starts from this prereg's filing date (2026-09-05) per the kill_criteria n-floor below.

hypothesis: H1: a SECOND independent wave (>= 60 minutes after the first entry, on a fresh two-trigger ENTER_BULL/ENTER_BEAR signal, with the first position at or past TP1) taken as a separate minimum-size lot while the first runner is still open has positive expectancy net of the extra catastrophe exposure it introduces (two concurrent option positions instead of one).
what_this_is_NOT: NOT averaging down and NOT adding to the SAME position -- memory C31 ('J's 667 real trades: 1-2 lots +$4,576 / 3+ lots -$17,461 / scaled-in -$327/trade -- killer is sizing-UP/adding, not flat count') and the standing guard `fb.is_flat_spy_options` (pinned by `backtest/tests/test_never_average_down_2026_07_20.py`) both govern adding TO an open position on the SAME trigger -- this hypothesis is explicitly a NEW, independently-triggered wave on a NEW two-trigger ENTER signal, not a re-entry or size-up on the existing runner.

NOT a change to params.json, strategies.py, exit_manager.py, heartbeat.md, heartbeat_core.py, or risk_gate -- config freeze holds through 2026-10-30. NOT_FLAT stays a hard refusal until a checkpoint proposal (if any) is separately ratified.
NOT permission to widen anything before 2026-10-30 -- this is a pre-registration, not a proposal to ship.

NOT a claim the full-window +$7,543 number is wrong -- it is real and disclosed above; the prereg exists because it is concentrated (63.4% one day) and the frozen forward-looking window reads the opposite sign.

the_spec.current_shape_under_test: NOT_FLAT gate: one open SPY 0DTE options position per account at a time; any second signal while a position is open is refused outright, regardless of the first position's stage (TP1 hit or not) or the gap since the first entry.
the_spec.candidate_finite_change: Admit a second wave as a SEPARATE minimum-size lot (never adding to the open position) ONLY when ALL of: (a) >= 60 minutes have elapsed since the first entry, (b) a fresh two-trigger ENTER_BULL/ENTER_BEAR fires independently of the first position's trigger, (c) the first position has reached TP1 (de-risked before a second concurrent exposure opens).
the_spec.instrument: analysis/right-tail/ledger.jsonl (per-date/arm `second_wave_summary.present`/`gap_minutes_from_first` fields, the >=60min + fresh-trigger gate this hypothesis's admission condition already matches) PLUS setup/scripts/gate_net_cost_walk.py's NOT_FLAT walked rows (analysis/gate-net-cost/GATE-NET-COST-2026-09-05.json, `gate_rows_deduped_to_waves` NOT_FLAT row) for the dollar expectancy. Both are existing, already-built instruments; this prereg reuses them, it does not extend either.
the_spec.unit_of_measure: per second-wave refusal event: realized_if_taken_dollars (the walked, real-exit-shape outcome) had the refused second wave instead been taken as a separate minimum-size lot.

kill_criteria.primary_kill: frozen-window net_dollars <= 0 (config-freeze window, 2026-08-31-onward, on the forward-accruing right-tail-ledger second-wave-refusal sample) evaluated at n>=20 second-wave refusals.
kill_criteria.concentration_kill: top-day concentration (best single wave-day's dollar contribution / total net_dollars, matching this table's own best_day_share_of_net convention, e.g. the full-window's disclosed 0.634) >= 0.5, evaluated at the same n>=20 floor.
kill_criteria.either_kill_closes_the_candidate: Either failure alone (frozen net <=0 OR ex-best-day net <=0 OR top-day concentration >=0.5, all three read from the same n>=20 forward sample) is sufficient to KILL; the candidate proceeds to a 2026-10-30 checkpoint SHADOW-FILE proposal only if none of the three fire.
kill_criteria.ex_best_day_kill: ex-best-day net_dollars <= 0 on the same forward n>=20 sample (the goal's DONE-WHEN names this as a third, independent leg of the kill bar alongside frozen-window net and top-day concentration).

extend_criterion: If n<20 forward second-wave refusals (the admission condition -- >=60min gap, fresh two-trigger ENTER, first position at/past TP1 -- is inherently rarer than a bare NOT_FLAT refusal; the ledger's all-time n_present_true count is 30 but that is BACKWARD and unfiltered by the TP1-reached condition) exist by 2026-10-30, the checkpoint reports UNVERIFIED -- insufficient n, not a negative finding (same convention as prereg-vix-bull-hard-cap-unblock-shadow-2026-09-05.json's extend_criterion) -- and the question stays open past 10-30.
n_needed: n>=20 forward second-wave refusals (post-2026-09-05, matching the admission condition (a)-(c) above) on the right-tail ledger, matching this project's standing evidence_n advisory bar.
consumer: 2026-10-30 config-freeze checkpoint review + GOAL-NOT-FLAT-SECOND-WAVE-PREREG-2026-09-05's DONE-WHEN clause; folded into analysis/recommendations/checkpoint-2026-09-29-inventory.json (class=expansion, ledger=right-tail/gate-net-cost) per W2.
